### Whether I Strive or Surrender, He Is Steadfast
Author: Meredith Boggs
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-january-3-2023.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 7:9
Points:
- Seasons of exhaustion and anxiety often condition believers to rely on constant striving rather than rest.
- God's covenant love does not fluctuate based on human performance or self-reliance.
- Just as God faithfully guided Israel despite their stubbornness, He remains faithful to His people today.
- Choosing surrender over striving releases the weight of shame and brings intimacy with God.

### Serious Matters Need a Serious God
Author: Tracie Miles
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/serious-matters-need-a-serious-god-encouragement-for-today-may-3-2013.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 7:9
Points:
- Difficult trials and unanswered prayers can tempt believers to distrust God's promises.
- Scripture repeatedly demonstrates that God means what He says and never breaks His word.
- God's covenant faithfulness assures believers that He cares deeply about their daily needs.
- Remembering God's past track record of provision fuels confidence during uncertain seasons.
